rulings.model: The form says 'Adjusted foreign tax carryover from prior tax year (combine lines 1 and 2)', but the restatement copies line 1 only. It drops the line 2b/2c adjustments ('Adjustments for section 905(c) redeterminations', 'Domestic audit adjustments') and names no refusal for that case.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; line 2 adjustments (section 905(c) redeterminations, domestic audit adjustments, a carryback adjustment) are refused on Form 1116 line 35 by f1116sb.changed_if_carry ('Schedule B (Form 1116), line 2') and f1116.redetermination, so line 2 is empty and line 3 = line 1 on every return prepared (i1116sb, line 3 'combine lines 1 and 2'); the form note says 'line 2 is empty (an adjustment is refused)'. A carryback into 2025 from 2026 cannot exist on an original 2025 return.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; D1: nothing is carried back; a return whose 2024 year had room under its limit (or other foreign income untaxed) is refused by f1116sb.carryback ('Schedule B (Form 1116), line 7 (carryback to 2024)'), so line 7 is zero on every return prepared.
